snippet.title: Call Me, Liar  - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Your friends are on the line. One of them is lying. 📞

Call Me, Liar is a voice-first party game for 4–8 friends, set on a cheerful, slightly sinister TV game show. Make deals over private phone calls, then watch the truth come out on live TV.

Every show has 10 games:
☎️ Who's on the Line? – Disguised voices, unknown rooms. Which friend is which?
🤝 Rapid Pacts – Quick calls, a secret SHARE or TAKE, and a very public reputation.
🤡 Spot the Clown – One of you is secretly the Clown. Tell a few friends, but not too many.
🗳️ The Banishment – Build a coalition, cast a secret vote, banish someone's points.
⚡ Convince & Hit – Pick a target, seal your attack, watch the lightning (and the backfires).
💣 Bomb – Your partner holds the clue to your bomb. Do you trust their advice?
🎲 Last Laugh – Push your luck on live TV: bank it or risk it all while everyone watches.
🐇 Rabbit Race – Share (or fake) your inside tips, place your chips, cheer your rabbit.
📦 Dead Line – Hold the ticking capsule to earn. Toss it before the line goes dead.
✍️ Fine Print – Everyone gets the same bribe. It only pays if not too many of you sign.

Nobody gets eliminated. Everybody wins.*
*No one has ever won.

Coming soon to Steam.
🌐 callmeliar.com
X · TikTok · Instagram: @callmeliargame

#CallMeLiar #PartyGame #IndieGame
